plain_text:
Stropharia aeruginosa also know as Psilocybe aeruginosa is medium-sized green-blue mushroom. It grows in Europe , North America and Asia (Iran)

Toxicity

Toxicity and edibility of this mushroom is not well known. Some says that this species contains Psilocybin and Psilocin. But a research didn't detect these compounds in this mushroom.
